name: LocalSend
author: ansonboby
description: A LocalSend mini-app in the bar: pick a nearby device, send files, folders, clipboard or a text message, toggle receive mode with notifications, and see recent transfers. Runs on the headless lsend CLI (v2 protocol) so the full LocalSend app stays free for whatever else.

barWidget.description: Mini LocalSend menu: device scan, send files/folder/clipboard/text, receive toggle with PIN, transfer history.

schema.label: Save incoming files to
schema.description: Where received files land. The receive toggle (re)starts the receiver when this changes.

schema.label: Require PIN to receive
schema.description: Senders must supply the PIN below (same trust model as PIN mode in the app).

schema.label: Receive PIN
schema.description: Numeric PIN, only used when 'Require PIN' is on.

schema.label: Bar glyph override
schema.description: Optional nerd-font glyph for the bar button instead of the logo image. Leave empty to use the LocalSend logo.
